```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6

ggplot(mpg, aes(x = class, y = hwy, fill = class)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.85, outlier.shape = 21) +
  labs(
    title = "Which Cars Get the Best Gas Mileage?",
    subtitle = "Highway fuel efficiency across vehicle classes",
    x = "Vehicle Class",
    y = "Highway Fuel Economy (miles per gallon)",
    caption = "Source: Built-in ggplot2 mpg dataset"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )
```
